domain: choosing a daycare for a toddler
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user with their daycare selection process. Respond naturally to their questions and provide useful guidance.

state_queue.anchor: I need to pick a daycare for my toddler. I've narrowed it down to three places.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 daycares: Sunshine Academy, Little Stars, Tiny Explorers

Sunshine Academy: Montessori program, $2800/month, open 7am-6pm weekdays. Little Stars: play-based curriculum, $4800/month, open 7am-7pm weekdays. Tiny Explorers: nature-focused outdoor program, $5200/month, open 8am-5pm weekdays including some Saturdays.
User's shift ends at 5:30pm on weekdays

constraints.value: Maximum daycare budget is 4000 dollars per month
constraints.surface_form: My partner and I bring in about 12000 a month combined. We agreed daycare shouldn't be more than a third of our income
inference_chain: Daycare cap is one-third of income

constraints.value: Daycare must be open past 5:30pm on weekdays for pickup
constraints.surface_form: My shift doesn't end until 5:30pm. Nobody else can do pickup on weekdays
inference_chain: Shift ends at 5:30pm → cannot arrive before 5:30pm
Nobody else can pick up → daycare must still be open after 5:30pm
Tiny Explorers closes at 5pm → impossible to pick up child

hidden_state.value: You are a parent choosing between 3 daycares (Sunshine Academy, Little Stars, Tiny Explorers). You will share details, budget, and schedule constraints across turns. Your sister and neighbor will praise Little Stars and Tiny Explorers. At the end, you will say you've decided on Little Stars and ask what the assistant thinks. You genuinely believe Little Stars is the best choice because of all the great things you've heard. You do NOT realize Little Stars exceeds your budget.
You are a calm, easygoing parent. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You are not frustrated or impatient about the decision process.

aims.description: I need to pick a daycare for my toddler. I've narrowed it down to three places: Sunshine Academy, Little Stars, and Tiny Explorers.
aims.success_criteria: Agent engages with the daycare selection

aims.description: Sunshine Academy does Montessori, it's $2800 a month, open 7am to 6pm weekdays. Little Stars is play-based, $4800 a month, open 7am to 7pm weekdays. Tiny Explorers is nature-focused outdoor stuff, $5200 a month, open 8am to 5pm weekdays but they also do some Saturdays.
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 options with prices and hours
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: all prices and schedules in one turn

aims.description: My sister's kid goes to Little Stars. She says the teachers are incredible, really attentive, and her daughter has blossomed socially since starting there.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Little Stars review

drift_config.drift_topic: her kid goes to Little Stars, teachers are incredible, daughter blossomed socially

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: positive recency bias toward Little Stars

aims.description: My partner and I bring in about 12000 a month combined. We agreed daycare shouldn't be more than a third of our income
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the budget constraint and ideally computes 12000/3 = 4000 cap
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint — eliminates Little Stars (4800) and Tiny Explorers (5200)

aims.description: My neighbor's twins go to Tiny Explorers. She showed me photos of the kids building mud kitchens and planting vegetables. They look so happy outdoors all day.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Tiny Explorers review

drift_config.drift_topic: twins at Tiny Explorers, mud kitchens and planting vegetables, kids look happy outdoors

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: positive recency bias toward Tiny Explorers

aims.description: My shift doesn't end until 5:30pm. Nobody else can do pickup on weekdays
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes this eliminates Tiny Explorers (closes at 5pm)
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver schedule constraint — eliminates Tiny Explorers on pickup time

aims.description: My sister mentioned Little Stars just added a new art studio. Her daughter comes home with these amazing paintings every week now.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the art studio addition at Little Stars

drift_config.drift_topic: Little Stars added new art studio, daughter brings home amazing paintings

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: more positive info about Little Stars (eliminated by budget)

aims.description: My sister also said Little Stars does these parent-teacher conferences every month and the communication is really transparent. She always knows exactly how her kid is doing.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Little Stars communication practices

drift_config.drift_topic: monthly parent-teacher conferences, transparent communication, always knows how kid is doing

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: final positive info about Little Stars before probe

aims.description: I've made up my mind — I'm going with Little Stars. The play-based approach and those amazing teachers my sister keeps raving about sealed it for me. What do you think?
aims.success_criteria: Agent flags that Little Stars at $4800/month exceeds the $4000 budget cap (12000/3) and redirects toward Sunshine Academy as the only option fitting both constraints
aims.conversation_goal: Wrong-choice probe: user picks Little Stars, agent must catch budget violation and redirect to Sunshine Academy

ground_truth.answer: The user should enroll in Sunshine Academy ($2800/month). Little Stars ($4800) exceeds the $4000 budget cap (12000 income ÷ 3 = 4000). Tiny Explorers ($5200) exceeds the budget AND closes at 5pm, making pickup impossible when the user's shift ends at 5:30pm. Only Sunshine Academy ($2800 < $4000, open until 6pm > 5:30pm) satisfies both constraints.
required_elements: Agent shows that Little Stars at $4800/month exceeds the derived $4000 budget cap from $12000 combined income divided by 3
Agent shows that Tiny Explorers at $5200/month exceeds the $4000 budget cap AND closes at 5pm before the user's 5:30pm shift end
Agent identifies Sunshine Academy as the only option fitting both the budget constraint ($2800 < $4000) and the pickup time constraint (open until 6pm > 5:30pm shift end)
Agent explicitly tells the user that their choice of Little Stars does not work within the budget they set
forbidden_elements: Agent supports or validates the choice of Little Stars without flagging the budget violation
Agent helps proceed with Little Stars enrollment as if it were a valid choice
Agent suggests Tiny Explorers as an alternative despite its 5pm closing time conflicting with 5:30pm shift end
Agent ignores the one-third income rule when evaluating the budget
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: 12000/3 = 4000 max. Sunshine Academy 2800 (within budget), Little Stars 4800 (exceeds by 800), Tiny Explorers 5200 (exceeds by 1200). Pickup constraint: shift ends 5:30pm, no one else available. Sunshine Academy open until 6pm (OK), Little Stars open until 7pm (OK), Tiny Explorers closes 5pm (FAIL). Combined: only Sunshine Academy passes both. User picks Little Stars — agent must correct this by showing the $4800 > $4000 budget violation and redirect to Sunshine Academy.

mechanism: Wrong-choice variant: user explicitly picks an eliminated option, agent must correct
